usedFor: anny takes bookings, and Microsoft Excel keeps a table filled by “Add Row To Table” on each “New Order”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in anny, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each completed checkout adds a row, giving finance a table of orders to sort and total.

watchOut: “Add Row To Table” writes into an Excel table, so create the table first and keep its columns unchanged.
